title: Executed decision origins and within-depth action entropy of the deployed rules

quantities.same_depth_action_entropy: entropy (nats) of the executed actions among D_test decisions at the same controlled depth, averaged over depths with weights equal to their decision counts
quantities.fraction_schedule_nominal: fraction of D_test decisions taken from a fixed schedule or the nominal action
quantities.fraction_state_conditioned: fraction of D_test decisions chosen by a one-step or radius score of the current measurements
quantities.fraction_exclusive_sequence: fraction of D_test decisions taken from a receding-horizon planned sequence
quantities.fraction_recovery: fraction of D_test decisions that are registered recovery actions
quantities.fraction_input_fallback: fraction of D_test decisions on inputs returned to q_C by the input gate or by a global q_C return

notes: The five fractions of a dataset sum to one. Sealed runs keep per-decision origins only for whole-graph executions, so graph-level traces must be exported from the serving-time execution records.
